branches.title: Text & lines
branches.description: Read the printed words, line edges and highlights. The George Sand clue makes the original line breaks matter.
branches.nextAction: Keep the printed line breaks and the p77r09 case alternatives. Page 75’s scans do not establish the original text-frame width. A publisher production excerpt with the frame and nonprinting break marks visible could distinguish an inserted return from automatic wrapping.

branches.title: Mirrors & layout

branches.title: Numbers & typography
branches.description: Inspect printed numbers and letterforms. A key-sized bit string or an unusual typeface is a lead to test, not a solution.
branches.nextAction: Seek a provenance-backed layout retaining glyph outlines separately from inverse fields. Compare the same 13 contact cases before repairing spacing; the second retained view still leaves them uncertified.
